question: What did Jesus say the Pharisees did before men?
explanation: Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts.

question: What did Jesus say is abomination in the sight of God?
choices: That which is highly esteemed among men
explanation: That which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.

question: Until whom did Jesus say the law and the prophets were?
explanation: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached.

question: What did Jesus say is easier than for one tittle of the law to fail?
choices: For a camel to pass through a needle
For heaven and earth to pass
explanation: It is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.

question: How did the rich man fare every day?
explanation: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day.

question: Whom did the rich man see afar off in hell?
choices: Abraham, with Lazarus in his bosom
explanation: In hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

question: What did Abraham tell the rich man to remember?
choices: He received good things and Lazarus evil things in life
explanation: Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things.

question: What stood between the rich man and Abraham?
explanation: Between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot.

question: What did Jesus ask would not be given to one unfaithful in another man's?
explanation: If ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?

question: What did Jesus say of whoever puts away his wife and marries another?
explanation: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery.

question: What did the rich man ask Lazarus to dip in water?
explanation: Send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue.

question: Why did the rich man want Lazarus to testify to his brethren?
choices: So they would sell his house
Lest they come into the place of torment
explanation: That he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.

question: What did the rich man think would make his brethren repent?
choices: One going to them from the dead
explanation: If one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.

question: What did Abraham say would not persuade them even if it happened?
explanation: If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.

question: Where was Lazarus laid?
explanation: There was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate.

question: To whom did Jesus speak the parable of the steward?
explanation: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward.

question: What was the steward ashamed to do?
explanation: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.

question: What did Jesus say every man does since John's time?
choices: Presseth into the kingdom of God
explanation: Since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.

question: What came and licked Lazarus's sores?
explanation: Moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.

question: Whose house did the rich man want Lazarus sent to?
explanation: I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house.

question: When did Jesus say the friends would receive you into everlasting habitations?
explanation: Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.

question: What did Jesus say of him that is unjust in the least?
choices: He is unjust also in much
explanation: He that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

question: What did Jesus say a servant of two masters will do to one of them?
choices: Flatter the one, and fear the other
Hate the one, and love the other
explanation: Either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other.

question: Which ruler heard of all that was done and was perplexed?
explanation: Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by Jesus and was perplexed.

question: How many baskets of fragments were taken up after the five thousand ate?
explanation: There was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.

question: About how many men were in the crowd Jesus fed?
explanation: They were about five thousand men.

question: Which three disciples did Jesus take up the mountain?
explanation: Jesus took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.

question: What did Peter offer to make on the mountain?
explanation: Peter said, Let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

question: What did the voice out of the cloud tell the disciples to do?
explanation: The voice said, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

question: What did Jesus do with the loaves before breaking them?
choices: Looked up to heaven and blessed them
explanation: He took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake.

question: What did James and John want to command to come down on the Samaritan village?
explanation: They said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them?

question: What did Jesus do after rebuking the unclean spirit in the boy?
choices: Healed the child and gave him back to his father
Told him to tell no man
explanation: Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.

question: What did Jesus set by him when the disciples argued about who was greatest?
explanation: Jesus took a child, and set him by him.

question: What did Jesus tell the twelve to take for their journey?
explanation: He said, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money.

question: What were the twelve to do when a city would not receive them?
choices: Shake off the dust from their feet
explanation: Whosoever will not receive you, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

question: Why was Herod perplexed about Jesus?
choices: The people wanted Jesus as king
Some said John was risen from the dead
explanation: He was perplexed because it was said of some that John was risen from the dead.

question: Where did Jesus take the apostles privately when they returned?
choices: The house of Peter in Capernaum
A desert place belonging to Bethsaida
explanation: He went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.

question: How did Jesus have the multitude sit down?
explanation: He said, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.

question: What did the twelve ask Jesus to do with the multitude as the day wore away?
choices: Let them sleep on the hill
Send them away to find lodging and food
explanation: They said, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals.

question: What did Jesus answer when the twelve wanted the crowd sent away?
explanation: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat.

question: Besides John the Baptist and Elias, who did people say Jesus was?
choices: One of the old prophets risen again
explanation: Some said John the Baptist; some Elias; and others that one of the old prophets is risen again.

question: After Peter said Jesus was the Christ of God, what did Jesus charge the disciples?
explanation: He straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing.

question: Who did Jesus say would reject the Son of man?
choices: The elders, chief priests and scribes
explanation: The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes.

question: What did Jesus ask a man would lose if he gained the whole world?
explanation: What is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?

question: What did Moses and Elias speak of on the mountain?
explanation: They spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.

question: What were Peter and those with him doing as Jesus talked with Moses and Elias?
explanation: Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep.

question: What did the man say of his son when he begged Jesus to look upon him?
explanation: The man said, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.

question: What had the disciples failed to do for the man's son?
explanation: The man said, I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.

question: What did Jesus say foxes and birds of the air have that the Son of man lacks?
explanation: Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

question: What did Jesus tell the man who first wanted to go and bury his father?
choices: Let the dead bury their dead
explanation: Jesus said, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.

question: What did Jesus say about the man who puts his hand to the plough and looks back?
choices: He is not fit for the kingdom of God
explanation: No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

question: What did Jesus say of the man casting out devils in his name whom the disciples forbade?
choices: He that is not against us is for us
explanation: Jesus said, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.

question: What does Luke say of Peter's words about the three tabernacles?
choices: He knew not what he said
explanation: Luke says Peter spoke not knowing what he said.

question: How long after these sayings did Jesus go up the mountain?
explanation: It came to pass about an eight days after these sayings.

question: What happened to Jesus as he prayed on the mountain?
choices: The fashion of his countenance was altered
He was lifted from the ground
explanation: As he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.

question: How did the disciples feel as they entered the cloud?
explanation: A cloud overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.

question: How did the disciples respond to Jesus' saying that the Son of man would be delivered into the hands of men?
choices: They understood not and feared to ask
They asked who would do it
explanation: It was hid from them; and they feared to ask him of that saying.

question: What did Jesus say he would do about those ashamed of him and his words?
choices: The Son of man will be ashamed of them in his glory
explanation: Whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory.

question: What did Jesus say some standing there would not taste of before they saw the kingdom of God?
explanation: There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.

question: What did Jesus say the Son of man is not come to do?
explanation: The Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them.

question: What did Jesus say to James and John when they asked to call down fire?
choices: Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of
Fire is for the Lord to send
Wait until the hour is come
explanation: He turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.

question: Where did Jesus stedfastly set his face to go when the time came for him to be received up?
explanation: When the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem.

question: What did Jesus say about the one who would save his life?
explanation: Whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
